$comment: Source of truth for Runic Views Window host support per runtime identifier. tools/dotnet-runic/metadata/generate.mjs embeds it in the CLI compatibility set and renders the README support table; eng/support.test.mjs keeps ci-verified entries in line with the Native job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. RIDs that are not listed are unsupported.

statuses.ci-verified: Runic CI builds and runs the host's native window layer on this RID for changes that affect it.
statuses.packaged-unverified: The packages ship native assets for it, but Runic CI does not run it. Test the published application on a real target machine.
statuses.unsupported: Runic does not ship the native assets the host needs.
